lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll look at a tiny ending that tells people you are talking about the past. It’s... …THE -ED ENDING! It has three different sounds, like in: DECIDED

Saying -ed correctly makes your past tense clear to everyone. If we add one more syllable, our English sounds heavy and unnatural.
